title: Patio Umbrella Netting 230CM Height Polyester Mesh Parasol Protective Screen Fit 250-300CM Umbrellas
body_html: 1、Protective Netting: Featuring protective and ventilated effect, this netting allows you to stay comfortable inside, very suitable for camping, hiking and outdoor travel. 2、User Friendly: This patio umbrella netting has a large space, allowing you to move around easily, equipped with zippers inside and outside, easy to open and close. 3、Easy Door Opening: This parasol net features double zippers door opening design, which can be pulled inside and outside, up and down, overlapped in the middle. 4、Bottom Design: This outdoor umbrella screen is lightweight and portable. Add a vertical feel all around and let it blow gently. 5、Specifications and Use: This outdoor umbrella netting has a height of 230CM and a circumference of 10M, and is suitable for 250-300CM umbrellasItem Type: Patio Umbrella NettingProduct Material: PolyesterNet Height: Approx. 230cm / 90.6inNet Circumference: Approx. 10m / 32.8ftApplicable Umbrella: Approx. 250-300cm / 98.4-118.1in1 x Patio Umbrella Netting
